recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed in core or in the current Extension Pack for FHIR-19377; future maintenance of these Questionnaire extension definitions should happen in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire issue requesting review of questionnaire-optionExclusive and questionnaire-usageMode because they were labeled modifier extensions; the accepted resolution was to make them not modifier.
initial_application: Git commit a671d22cc52ba84fd280945f700df4d2e0976309, "GF#19377 Q extensions not modifiers", removed the old modifier flag and rationale cells for optionExclusive and usageMode from source/questionnaire/questionnaire-extensions-spreadsheet.xml. Historical generated artifacts show release3 had isModifier=true for both extensions and release4 had isModifier=false.
additional_context: Current core still includes Questionnaire but no longer owns the individual Questionnaire extension StructureDefinitions. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the Questionnaire extension definitions from R5 core source. Current core has only the Questionnaire extension IG stub and OID assignments for the two canonicals, while the maintained Extension Pack files define questionnaire-optionExclusive and questionnaire-usageMode without an isModifier override. The already-published FHIR-12173 audit on the combined branch documents the optionExclusive source move and cites FHIR-19377 as the later modifier-status change.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was changed because editing core would duplicate artifacts now maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack, and those maintained definitions already reflect the FHIR-19377 decision by remaining non-modifier.
